Repeat.

An opponent controls a creature.

1011-2438-2728-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.

Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.

If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

1669-3234-3293-5686.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
